versions.content: Mapping of Software Components to ECUs 14 of 42  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 213: AUTOSAR_RS_SystemTemplate Requirements on System Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The System Template has to describe the mapping of software components to ECUs. An optional mapping of software components to individual processing units residing in one ECU shall also be possible. Rationale:  Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: For safety reasons (or simply due to the experience) some specific Software Components can run only on some specific ECUs. Such "pre-mapping" is a constraint for the real mapping process. Supporting Material: 
